pairs: Anno septimo Jehu,
In the seventh year of Jehu,
regnavit Joas:
Jehoash reigned.
et quadraginta annis regnavit in Jerusalem.
And he reigned for forty years in Jerusalem.
Nomen matris ejus Sebia de Bersabee.
The name of his mother was Zebiah from Beersheba.
Fecitque Joas rectum coram Domino cunctis diebus quibus docuit eum Jojada sacerdos.
And Jehoash did what was right in the sight of the Lord, during all the days that Jehoiada, the priest, taught him.
Verumtamen excelsa non abstulit:
Yet still he did not take away the high places.
adhuc enim populus immolabat,
For the people were still immolating,
et adolebat in excelsis incensum.
and burning incense, in the high places.
Dixitque Joas ad sacerdotes:
And Jehoash said to the priests:
Omnem pecuniam sanctorum,
“All of the money for the holy things,
quæ illata fuerit in templum Domini a prætereuntibus,
which has been brought into the temple of the Lord from those who pass by,
quæ offertur pro pretio animæ,
which is offered for the price of a soul,
et quam sponte
and which they bring into the temple of the Lord willingly,
et arbitrio cordis sui inferunt in templum Domini:
from their own free heart:
accipiant illam sacerdotes juxta ordinem suum,
let the priests, according to their ranks,
et instaurent sartatecta domus, si quid necessarium viderint instauratione.
take and use it in order to repair the surfaces of the house, wherever they see anything in need of repair.”
Igitur usque ad vigesimum tertium annum regis Joas,
And yet, even until the twenty-third year of king Jehoash,
non instauraverunt sacerdotes sartatecta templi.
the priests did not repair the surfaces of the temple.
Vocavitque rex Joas Jojadam pontificem et sacerdotes,
And king Jehoash called the high priest, Jehoiada, and the priests,
dicens eis:
saying to them:
Quare sartatecta non instauratis templi?
“Why have you not repaired the surfaces of the temple?
nolite ergo amplius accipere pecuniam juxta ordinem vestrum,
Therefore, you may no longer accept money according to your ranks. Instead,
sed ad instaurationem templi reddite eam.
return it in order that the temple may be repaired.”
Prohibitique sunt sacerdotes ultra accipere pecuniam a populo, et instaurare sartatecta domus.
And so the priests were prohibited from accepting any more money from the people to repair the surfaces of the house.
Et tulit Jojada pontifex gazophylacium unum,
And the high priest, Jehoiada, took a certain chest,
aperuitque foramen desuper,
and he opened a hole in the top,
et posuit illud juxta altare ad dexteram ingredientium domum Domini:
and he placed it beside the altar, to the right of those who were entering the house of the Lord.
mittebantque in eo sacerdotes qui custodiebant ostia, omnem pecuniam quæ deferebatur ad templum Domini.
And the priests who kept the doors put all the money in it which was being brought into the temple of the Lord.
Cumque viderent nimiam pecuniam esse in gazophylacio,
And when they saw that there was a great amount of money in the chest,
ascendebat scriba regis, et pontifex,
the scribe of the king and the high priest went up and poured it out.
effundebantque et numerabant pecuniam quæ inveniebatur in domo Domini:
And they counted the money that was found in the house of the Lord.
et dabant eam juxta numerum
And they gave it out,
atque mensuram in manu eorum qui præerant cæmentariis domus Domini:
by number and measure,
qui impendebant eam in fabris lignorum
to the hands of those who were over the masons of the house of the Lord.
et in cæmentariis,
And they weighed it out to the carpenters and masons,
iis qui operabantur in domo Domini,
to those who were working in the house of the Lord
et sartatecta faciebant:
and restoring the surfaces,
et in iis qui cædebant saxa,
and to those who were cutting stones,
et ut emerent ligna,
and buying timber
et lapides,
and stones to be cut,
qui excidebantur,
so that the repairs to the house of the Lord might be finished:
ita ut impleretur instauratio domus Domini in universis quæ indigebant expensa ad muniendam domum.
for all that was needed toward the expenses in order to strengthen the house.
Verumtamen non fiebant ex eadem pecunia hydriæ templi Domini,
Yet truly, from the same money, they did not make for the temple of the Lord water pitchers,
et fuscinulæ,
or small hooks,
et thuribula, et tubæ,
or censers, or trumpets,
et omne vas aureum et argenteum,
or any vessel of gold or silver,
de pecunia quæ inferebatur in templum Domini.
from the money that was brought into the temple of the Lord.
Iis enim qui faciebant opus,
For it was given to those who were doing the work,
dabatur ut instauraretur templum Domini:
so that the temple of the Lord might be repaired.
et non fiebat ratio iis hominibus qui accipiebant pecuniam ut distribuerent eam artificibus,
And they did not ration the money to the men who received it in order to distribute it to the artisans. Instead,
sed in fide tractabant eam.
they bestowed it with faith.
Pecuniam vero pro delicto,
Yet truly, the money for offenses and the money for sins,
et pecuniam pro peccatis non inferebant in templum Domini,
they did not bring into the temple of the Lord,
quia sacerdotum erat.
since it was for the priests.
Tunc ascendit Hazaël rex Syriæ,
Then Hazael, the king of Syria,
et pugnabat contra Geth,
ascended and fought against Gath,
cepitque eam:
and he captured it.
et direxit faciem suam ut ascenderet in Jerusalem.
And he directed his face, so that he might ascend against Jerusalem.
Quam ob rem tulit Joas rex Juda omnia sanctificata quæ consecraverant Josaphat,
For this reason, Jehoash, the king of Judah,
et Joram, et Ochozias,
took all the sanctified things,
patres ejus reges Juda,
which Jehoshaphat, and Jehoram,
et quæ ipse obtulerat:
and Ahaziah, his fathers,
et universum argentum quod inveniri potuit in thesauris templi Domini et in palatio regis:
the kings of Judah, had consecrated and which he himself had offered, and all the silver that could be found in the treasuries of the temple of the Lord and in the palace of the king,
misitque Hazaëli regi Syriæ,
and he sent it to Hazael, the king of Syria.
et recessit ab Jerusalem.
And so he withdrew from Jerusalem.
Reliqua autem sermonum Joas,
Now the rest of the words of Jehoash,
et universa quæ fecit,
and all that he did,
nonne hæc scripta sunt in libro verborum dierum regum Juda?
have these not been written in the book of the words of the days of the kings of Judah?
Surrexerunt autem servi ejus, et conjuraverunt inter se,
Then his servants rose up and conspired among themselves.
percusseruntque Joas in domo Mello in descensu Sella.
And they struck down Jehoash, at the house of Millo, on the descent of Silla.
Josachar namque filius Semaath,
For Jozacar, the son of Shimeath,
et Jozabad filius Somer servi ejus,
and Jehozabad, the son of Shomer,
percusserunt eum,
his servants, struck him,
et mortuus est:
and he died.
et sepelierunt eum cum patribus suis in civitate David:
And they buried him with his fathers in the city of David.
regnavitque Amasias filius ejus pro eo.
And Amaziah, his son, reigned in his place.
